question: Should OpenClaw accept Podman agent sandboxing as a bundled official plugin in this repository, or require it to live first as an external ClawHub/npm plugin?
rationale: The existing sandbox plugin seam appears sufficient, but bundling this backend changes official sandbox posture, plugin config/dependencies, generated docs, and public SDK/API expectations.

options.title: Review as bundled backend
options.body: Sponsor the linked PR as the official Podman backend, then require security, dependency, SDK/API, rebase, and runtime proof before merge.

options.title: External plugin first
options.body: Ask the contributor to publish a ClawHub/npm plugin using the existing sandbox SDK seam and revisit bundling after adoption or a concrete missing API is found.

options.title: Fold into broader backend planning
options.body: Defer the narrow Podman backend until the broader execution-backend and resource-profile direction in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/82017 is settled.

recommendation.title: Review as bundled backend
recommendation.body: Sponsor the linked PR as the official Podman backend, then require security, dependency, SDK/API, rebase, and runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The OpenShell sandbox backend and recent sandbox docs/API history make this the clearest available owner for the bundled-backend product decision.
